invariants: Cognitive strategies are contracts, not personalities.
Unknown remains unknown until observed or otherwise evidenced.
Consequential actions remain governed by policy and HumanGate outside this registry.

strategies.purpose: Use exact or deterministic methods before probabilistic reasoning when applicable.
Retrieve scoped sources and preserve exact provenance.
Establish current state without converting unknowns into assumptions.
Generate competing explanations from incomplete observations.
Rebuild the problem from fundamental constraints instead of inherited conventions.
Trace a claimed limitation to its origin, assumptions, counterexamples and discriminating tests.
Attempt to falsify a proposal with independent evidence and deterministic checks.
Map dependencies, externalities and blast radius before action.
Enumerate unknowns, tail risks and conditions that must block execution.
Distinguish correlation, mechanism and intervention hypotheses.
Run a model of possible outcomes only when simulator fidelity has evidence.
Build the smallest reversible experiment that can discriminate between hypotheses.
